Ce genre de détail fait toute la différence quand on voyage en famille. Le logement lui-même était parfait : belle terrasse, cuisine qui possède tous les essentiels, lits très confortables avec des oreillers en mousse mémoire, serviettes en abondance, shampoing + revitalisant et un bon séchoir à cheveux. Rien ne manquait. Le quartier est un vrai coup de cœur: vivant, mais paisible, avec plein de cafés, bars et restos à deux pas, et le métro est aussi très accessible. On reviendrait sans hésiter. Merci Alejandro!

- We had a wonderful 4 days in Barcelona at Alejandro's flat. Despite being relatively compact the flat felt bright and airy, with high ceilings, and it was equipped everything you could possibly need. The outdoor terrace was a particular highlight. - Great place!
- Excelente ubicación, fiel a las fotos. Alejandro y Andy siempre pendientes de nuestra estadía. Recomendado

- This is one of the nicest Airbnb‘s we have ever stayed at. It was clean, functional, and spacious. The hosts were very responsive with maintenance and other requests. Some notes to help others: 1. There are electric shades built into the street facing windows. Be sure to look for the up/down buttons on the wall! 2. There is a washer but no dryer. This seems to be standard for this region but if you come from a region that typically uses a dryer that may catch you off guard. There is a drying rack provided and a courtyard to easily hang clothes to dry. 3. There is quite a bit of street noise late at night. You may want to consider ear plugs if you are not a deep sleeper. I think this is just typical city noise but if you are not used to it, it might be bothersome.

- Nous avons passé le weekend dans cet appartement, une réservation pour 6 personnes. Une seule chambre est grande et au calme, les deux autres chambres ont les fenêtres qui s'ouvre directement sur le couloir des parties communes de l'immeuble. Elles sont collés aux escaliers et a l'ascenseur qui est très bruyant et utilisé a tout heure. Le sonomètre est inscrit dans les équipements présent mais dans aucun cas sur la description de l'annonce . Il c'est déclenché à 22h alors que nous parlions a 6 personnes dans le salon. Un logement pour 6 personnes est obligatoirement bruyant, déclencher un sonomètre pour si peu est aberrant. Il n'y avait pas de condiments dans la cuisine alors que le sel, poivre huile était présent dans les équipements de l'annonce. Bien trop cher pour le peu d'isolation.
- We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Alejandro’s place. The location was fantastic, making it easy to access public transportation or explore the city on foot
- Overall great experience, the property was located within 20 mins walk from main attractions. We had an issue with drain, however, Alejandro had it fixed within 24hrs. Highly recommend it.
- Excelente lugar, muy bien ubicado y cómodo para disfrutar unos días en barcelona en familia. El supermercado está a unos cuantos pasos de distancia. Volveríamos felices.

- This apartment is clean and in an excellent location. As a group of 7 young women we all felt extremely safe in this area and all of the attractions that we wanted to see during our stay were within a 45 minute walk or 20 minute uber away. Unfortunately we were not given enough dishwasher detergents or toilet paper during our stay. However, the host is very attentive and I’m sure if you were to ask for these things then they would bring them.

- El lugar no está mal pero la experiencia con el administrador ha sido una gran decepción para nosotros. Llegamos al lugar realmente cansados y tanto el mecanismo de entrada como las desinteresadas respuestas de quienes están detrás de la gestión del lugar, nos han convencido que no son para nada recomendables. Tuvimos un día difícil después de un retraso en el aeropuerto y tener que haber esperado más de una hora en la calle siguiendo al pie de la letra el mecanismo roto de entrada y las inútiles respuestas recibidas, ha sido simplemente insultante. Alejandro tiene una serie de automatismos que ignoran tus peticiones reales pero seguramente aparecerá como si fuera un anfitrión de respuestas rápidas. Te responde de una manera que resulta insultante a tus necesidades reales ya que sólo te envía un texto devuelta que poco a nada tiene que ver con algo que realmente de importe a ti como huésped. No lo recomiendo, el lugar y la ubicación no está mal pero la gestión es insultante.
- nonostante piccolezze date da abitudini italiane ci siamo trovate bene soprattutto grazie alla zona sicura, ben servita e tranquilla.
- Very pleasant Stay. Host was very approachable and addressed all the requirements.
- Beautiful apartment in a great location. Helpful and responsive host. We really enjoyed our stay!

- My family of four and pet had a great stay at Alejandro’s place. We were allowed to leave our luggage before the check in time. Which is a plus if you arrive early to the city. It gives you time to explore around the neighborhood. The apartment in general was very clean, which is a huge plus. Alejandro was very responsive as well and shared his recommendations of places to visit. I 100% recommend this place.
- Cute, simple, exactly as pictured in a great neighborhood. Morning coffee on the terrace was the best part!

- Ci siamo trovati bene nell’alloggio di Alejandro. Posizione comoda per raggiungere i posti interessati della Barcelona. La casa aveva tutto, l’unica cosa peccata non aveva la macchina del caffè a capsule. Il resto tutto pulito. Consiglio

- Apartment was in a great spot in Grecia. Great shopping and little cafe's and eateries everywhere. 20 minute to the Segrada which was simply amazing. Apartment had high ceilings, everything worked. I recommend turning the A/C on as soon as you arrive and let permeate the apartment, takes awhile but eventually the rooms cooled off. Was super easy getting into, Alejandro sends a video that walks you through the simple steps. Was a breeze. After that, you just use keys. It is located near a neat little square and there is foot traffic and some noise, but did not bother any of us at all. Grocery store 10 ft from the apartment building, waters etc...the outdoor patio is large and great to relax with a cold beverage. There is a cute little shop on one of the corners of the square (forgot the name) that sold the best shaved ice I've ever had highly recommend plus, was also very warm while we were there. Directly across the square was a small eatery called "OZ," place was AWESOME. Recommend.
- Het verblijf bij Alejandro was super! Het appartement was enorm schoon en de communicatie was ook erg fijn.
- Bell'appartamento situato in una zona molto carina e con collegamenti vicini. Ci siamo sentiti come a casa. Lo spazio in terrazza veramente gradevole. Ottima esperienza!

- A great apartment in a fantastic location. Lots of local bars and restaurants within walking distance, including a great square with bakeries, ice cream parlours, shops and bars/restaurants 1 minute from the door. The apartment is airy and cool thanks to very efficient AC in the living room and ceiling fans in the bedrooms. The terrace is large and perfect for an evening meal or drink while watching the world go by on the narrow streets below. My kids slept really well throughout, but a mild warning to those with young families or any light sleepers.... This is a city centre apartment on the first floor, the city doesn't sleep until 3am or later and you will naturally hear people heading home from bars, street cleaners, bin lorries and all of the sounds of the city overnight. That said, I would very much recommend the apartment and would be more than happy to stay there again myself one day. Thank you Alejandro and the other hosts for your clear instructions throughout

- Sehr schöne Unterkunft. Von Anfang bis Ende- im Vorfeld sehr nette und schnelle Kommunikation. Gute Einweisung, sehr sehr saubere Wohnung. Bei Nachfragen oder kleinen Problemen- sofortige hilfsbereite Antworten. Jederzeit wieder und sehr zu empfehlen!!!!

- What an absolutely gorgeous apartment in a fantastic location! We were lucky enough to be right in the middle of the Fiesta da Gracia to experience music and festival feel. The apartment had everything we needed, and the terrace was a real bonus.

- Séjour très bien passé chez Juan et Alejandro. L’appartement était propre, bien équipé. Alejandro nous a envoyé les messages d’information en amont de notre visite (pré-enregistrés) tandis que Juan a pris soin de nous aider lors du séjour pour nos différentes questions. Certains de nos messages ont nécessité des relances (parfois sans retour..) mais il ne faut pas hésiter à insister. Nous remercions d’ailleurs très chaleureusement Juan pour ses recommandations (ainsi que pour la page très bien faite) qui ont pu nous faire économiser dans nos dépenses ! Les ventilateurs au plafond étaient superbes et nous ont garanti des nuits fraîches et agréables. Merci pour tout cela. ☀️

- Alejandro's home was great! The location was comfortable, peaceful and very walkable. The amenities were well appreciated and the terrace was a great spot after a long day. We truly enjoyed Alejandro's home and hope to stay again soon!

- Alejandro est très réactif et toujours d’excellents conseils notamment pour les restaurants. - très bon séjour je recommande
- We really enjoyed our stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location with many shops nearby. Communication with the host was quick and easy.

- Very good
- Great location, close to nice bars/ restaurants. One nice bright room perfect for two people and then one smaller room. Was fine for three people :)
- Un piso cómodo y accesible para visitar Barcelona. Recomendado!
- Very helpful host and lovely clean flat. The AC was wonderful during hot days!

- Lovely place and clear and helpful communication from Alejandro right through the process. Loved the digital key set up - so easy to get in without stress. Really nice area. Apartment a little small but comfortable and great to have the little terrace to get some air!

- Нам очень понравилось в этой квартире. Расположение близко к метро и многим достопримечательностям. В квартире есть все для комфортного пребывания для четверых. Заселение быстро и без проблем. Сервис отвечает на все запросы оперативно.

- Nice affordable place to stay in Barcelona.

- Merci Alejandro pour votre disponibilité. Vos conseils nous ont été précieux . Nous avons passé un excellent séjour et bien profité de l'emplacement de votre logement pour emprunter les transports qui se trouvent à proximité. Je recommande ce logement

- Alejandro var hela tiden mycket proaktiv och vänlig i sin kommunikation med oss. Det var tydliga instruktioner om boendet, hur man tar sig in, bekvämligheter, osv. - Comfortable appartment in a lovely area of Barcelona. Walkable and good transport connections which made it easy to explore the city . Lovely square very near by with visitors and locals enjoying the space . This area had a sense of community . There are lots of small local shops ,bars and cafes near by and several small supermarkets for food etc . I would return next time Im in Barcelona. Communication was clear friendly .

- Alejandro’s place was ideally situated for our family of four in Gràcia. We stayed during the Festa de Gràcia, a wonderfully lively five-day celebration that gave us a great sense of the neighborhood’s character. There was music and fireworks at all hours, so we can’t really comment on how quiet it is during a normal week. Despite the outside noise, the apartment felt like a welcome refuge, and with a fan running we were able to rest comfortably. The location is excellent—close to the main plaza, shops, countless restaurants, and within about a 20-minute walk of many Barcelona attractions. The kitchen is best suited for coffee and a simple breakfast rather than large meals, and there’s a balcony for outdoor seating in cooler weather. Access is via a narrow staircase, which was completely fine for us but worth noting for anyone with mobility concerns. Overall, Alejandro’s place was a fabulous base for exploring Gràcia and the rest of this vibrant, culturally rich city.

- Loved my stay at Alejandro’s place! It is super well located. The AC was super nice all throughout the apartment. The terrace was also very nice. Kitchen was well stocked with utensils. Would come back to stay again!
- Fin lejlighed i dejligt kvarter. Hjælpsom vært. Varm anbefaling herfra.

- The apartment was great, it had everything we needed, all the amenities, bit kitchen studio, outside terrace with a table. The host is proactive and responsive. Very clear and helpful instructions. Overall, experience was the most wonderful

- We had a great stay! The apartment had all the basic necessities and was a comfortable size for our group of four. We especially enjoyed the back terrace, the in-unit laundry, and the excellent AC and ceiling fans. The location was amazing, very central, close to great restaurants, and a grocery store nearby. Barcelona is a lively city, so some noise is expected. I had read reviews about the noise but didn't think it would be too noticeable. Unfortunately, the apartment has very little soundproofing, especially in the front bedroom with the terrace, where street noise was quite loud. We were able to make it work, but it's something to keep in mind if you're a light sleeper. Overall, we'd happily stay here again and would recommend it to anyone looking for a great location, as long as they don't mind some street noise.

- Ons verblijf bij het appartement van Alejandro in Poblenou was redelijk goed. Er was geen persoonlijke ontvangst, alle communicatie verliep via de app. Appartement bij aankomst openen via de vive app en sleutels lagen op de tafel. Even uitzoeken maar het werkt. Het gebouw is oud maar het appartement is opgefrist met witte wanden en een strakke vloer. De keuken is klein en de badkamer is ondermaats. Het is eigenlijk een nis in de hal. De douche was vies, toilet zitting versleten en je kijkt vanuit de douche in een gat met de afvoeren. Wij vonden het appartement redelijk in orde maar prijs/ kwaliteit niet helemaal in verhouding. Ook de balkons zijn klein, maar ze zijn er wel. Omgeving was goed. Dichtbij het strand. Openbaar vervoer verschillende opties dichtbij. De Rambla de Poblenou zit om de hoek en heeft veel restaurantjes en winkels.
- Communication was great and the team were quick to respond to our questions. The apartment was clean and tidy and the location was in walking distance for all we planned to see.

Nous recommandons vivement Alejandro et son logement et reviendrons avec grand plaisir !
